circumstances_desc: Allotment and issuance of new shares in the capital of Aspial Corporation pursuant to the Scrip Dividend Scheme (the "Allotment").  Following the Allotment, the total number of issued ordinary shares in Aspial Corporation ("Shares") increased from 2,212,205,858 Shares (excluding 26,428,515 treasury shares) to 2,254,395,325 Shares (excluding 26,678,515 treasury shares).
title: Change in Mlhs Holdings Pte Ltd's position in Aspial Corp Ltd
body: Mlhs Holdings Pte Ltd executed a transaction for 27,361,065 shares of Aspial Corp Ltd. This increases their holdings from 1,203,886,870 to 1,231,247,935 shares.

title: Change in Sasseur Asset Management Pte. Ltd's position in Sasseur REIT
body: Sasseur Asset Management Pte. Ltd executed a transaction for 4,202,375 shares of Sasseur REIT. This increases their holdings from 4,159,660 to 8,362,035 shares.
